title: Splitwatch sport preset
description: Official YouTube channels of one sport. The app checks these channels for live and upcoming streams. Only add channels that belong to a sport's organizer, league or federation and that stream on YouTube.

sport.description: The sport, which picks its name and, later, its theme.

id.description: The channel ID (UC followed by 22 characters), not the @handle.

checked.description: The day someone confirmed that the ID belongs to this channel and that it is active (YYYY-MM-DD).

review.description: Anything a maintainer should look at, such as ownership that is not confirmed.

keywords.description: Words added to a search when this sport is picked as a filter.
